title: Woods's partner frozen at the wheel
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I even tried pulling his hand off that steering wheel.
I could not figure out what was happening and turned to look at ------- and saw that both his hands were on the steering wheel and he was looking straight ahead with a blank stare on his face.

plain: As the glowing object hung over the missile site in 1977, Mario Woods says, his partner Michael Johnson sat frozen at the wheel of their vehicle and did not respond, and Woods even tried to pull his hand off the steering wheel. Woods, then an Air Force missile security guard, tells Michels this as something he saw. In his account published by the writer Robert Hastings on 10 September 2017, with the partner's name blanked out, he writes that "both his hands were on the steering wheel and he was looking straight ahead with a blank stare on his face", which, if true, suggests something had taken hold of the men.
